description: This file is a shell script for testing and scripting interactions with Perforce and Git, specifically cloning repositories, managing commits, and dealing with empty commits using git-p4.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts the Perforce daemon for testing.

methods.name: client_view
methods.description: Sets up the client workspace mappings for Perforce.

methods.name: p4 add
methods.description: Adds a file to Perforce version control.

methods.name: p4 delete
methods.description: Deletes a file from Perforce version control.

methods.name: git p4 clone
methods.description: Clones a Perforce depot into a Git repository using git-p4, with options to include specific changes and behaviors.
